shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone slab
horizontal registers stacked one above another
repeated rows of similar figures in profile
curved arc / dome-like repeated motifs along the top register
justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs carved in shallow relief with content organised into stacked horizontal registers separated by ruled lines, with repeated similar units within each band; that register scheme is the strongest correspondence but is a very general convention. What is depicted differs entirely: A shows a row of abstract arc/dome shapes over stylised zoomorphic or geometric forms and a quadruped below, while B shows anthropomorphic figures with raised arms, altar-like objects and rows of sign-like glyphs, none of which appear in A.
